project.name: WhatsApp Business Chatbots
project.description: Custom WhatsApp chatbots for any business — connected to your information, inventory and software to answer customers and handle everyday requests automatically.

caseStudy.statement: Your business knowledge. Your workflows. Available to customers on WhatsApp.
caseStudy.seoDescription: Custom WhatsApp chatbots for any business by Rafay Khattak. Automate customer enquiries, inventory checks, orders and requests with your existing tools.
caseStudy.heroNote: Custom integrations · Built around your business
caseStudy.technicalSummary: I connect WhatsApp conversations to the information and tools a business uses: Excel files, inventory systems, menus, service details and other accessible data sources. Each integration is scoped to the business's workflow and the access its systems support.

sections.title: Your customers have questions. Your team has work to do.

body.value: From product availability and prices to menus, opening hours and service enquiries, customers often need the same information. I build WhatsApp chatbots around your business so those conversations can move forward without someone manually answering every message.

sections.title: A chatbot that works with your business.

body.value: Connect the information you already maintain — Excel inventory, business software, a product catalogue, a menu or service information — to a WhatsApp chatbot. The workflow can answer questions, guide customers through choices and capture orders or requests. We define what it should handle and when your team should take over.

sections.title: Any business. A workflow of its own.

body.value: For retailers and wholesalers: product enquiries, pricing, availability and quantities from connected inventory.
For restaurants and food businesses: menu browsing, item selection and order capture in the conversation.
For service providers and other businesses: frequently asked questions, service information, lead capture and appointment requests, tailored to how your team works.
Your business does not need to fit a template. Tell me what customers ask, what you want to automate and which tools you use; I will scope the integration around that.

I completed a WhatsApp chatbot integration for a laptop store, connecting its inventory so customers could ask about products, prices and available quantities without waiting for a salesperson. That project is one application of the service — the chatbot and integrations can be tailored to a different business and workflow.

about.before: I'm studying Data Science at FAST-NUCES and building software professionally, from company websites and internal operations systems to AI-powered products. My latest specialty is WhatsApp automation: I connected a laptop store's inventory to a chatbot that answers customer enquiries automatically. I now offer inventory and software integrations for retailers, plus menu and ordering chatbots for restaurants.
